feedTitle: Workshops, Seminars & Undergraduate Research Registry [DEMO FEED]
licenseNotice: DEMO DATASET - Curated for educational discovery architecture testing. Not affiliated with live registrations.

items.title: CERN OpenLab Summer Student Research Programme 2027
items.description: Spend 9 weeks at CERN working with high-performance computing, quantum simulation, and machine learning architectures applied to Large Hadron Collider petabyte event reconstruction.
items.prizePool: Full daily living allowance (~90 CHF/day) & travel reimbursed

items.title: Stanford HAI Foundation Models Masterclass & Workshop
items.organization: Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence
items.description: A 5-day intensive technical workshop on scaling laws, multi-modal pre-training, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA), and mechanistic interpretability led by Stanford research faculty.
items.prizePool: Certified Stanford HAI Certificate of Completion

items.title: Carnegie Mellon Robotics Institute Summer Scholars (RISS)
items.description: An eleven-week undergraduate research immersion program where scholars conduct cutting-edge robotics research alongside world-class faculty in autonomous driving, manipulation, and perception.

items.title: Google Summer of Code (GSoC) 2027 Preparation Bootcamp
items.organization: Open Source Initiative & Google Open Source
items.description: A 4-week structured mentorship workshop series teaching students how to read large open-source codebases, craft compelling proposals, write clean Git PRs, and engage with maintainers.
items.prizePool: GSoC acceptance preparation toolkit & mentor reviews

items.title: Berkeley Quantum Computing Student Laboratory Workshop
items.description: Hands-on quantum algorithm design and circuit execution on real superconducting QPUs using Qiskit and Cirq. Theoretical lectures combined with quantum compiler optimization exercises.

items.title: Rust Foundation Systems Programming Masterclass
items.description: Comprehensive weekend deep dive into memory safety, borrow checker mastery, concurrent async runtimes (Tokio), and cross-compilation for WebAssembly microservices.

items.title: Harvard Berkman Klein Center Tech Policy Student Fellowship
items.description: Interdisciplinary semester research fellowship examining privacy law, digital human rights, automated decision transparency, and platform governance models.

items.title: MLSys Student Systems & Hardware Co-Design Seminar
items.description: Bi-weekly workshop exploring GPU kernel optimization with Triton, model quantization (4-bit/8-bit), and low-latency transformer inference pipelines.
items.prizePool: Conference paper review guidance & GPU cloud credits
